This template allows for selective linking to a game summary page depending on if the transcluding page is or is not the game summary page.  This is useful when the link is transcluded on multiple pages, but a link on the summary page is not desired.

== Usage ==
<code><nowiki>{{score link|SUMMARY PAGE#SECTION|LINK TEXT}}</nowiki></code>

or

<code><nowiki>{{score link|SUMMARY PAGE#SECTION|LINK TEXT|2ND SUMMARY PAGE}}</nowiki></code>

or

<code><nowiki>{{score link|SUMMARY PAGE#SECTION|LINK TEXT|2ND SUMMARY PAGE|3RD SUMMARY PAGE}}</nowiki></code>

== Example ==
See the main match summary in [[UEFA Euro 2004 Group A#Portugal vs Greece]] and the transcluded match summary in [[UEFA Euro 2004#Group A]].  In the main match summary, only the score is displayed, but in the transcluded summary a linked score is displayed.
